text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,884.5, up 0.25% on the day and 2.6% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 matched the move (0.25% daily, 1.93% weekly). Advances outpaced declines (251 vs 242) and the breadth score stayed in the “HEALTHY” zone at 64.8, indicating a fairly broad rally across the market. The India VIX fell 4.73% to 16.83, showing reduced volatility.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net sellers of futures, with a net short of 88,469 contracts and a 20‑day streak of net selling, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) added about ₹5,630 cr this session. The options market shows a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.03 for Nifty, suggesting slight bearish bias, with the max‑pain level at 25,800 and a call wall at 26,000. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 0.87 (bullish tilt), max‑pain at 63,500 and a call wall at 66,000. Leading sectors were realty, banks, IT and FMCG; weakening areas included pharma, auto and infrastructure.

Watch the Nifty 50 support at 25,753.68 and resistance at 25,995.13, plus the Bank Nifty pivot (P 63,657, R1 63,983). Key headlines to monitor are the possible India‑US trade‑deal acceleration, RBI’s upcoming variable‑rate repo auction, and any fresh FII inflows after the recent sentiment boost from global tech rotation. These could influence the next session’s direction.
